title: Vocal Intensity Conversion with Continuous SPL Control via Adversarial Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.13608v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vocal intensity conversion renders a recorded utterance at a different vocal intensity, rather than simply scaling its amplitude, while preserving its content and speaker identity. Existing systems control intensity through a reference utterance or a few discrete categories. Instead, we control the conversion with any target sound pressure level (SPL) on a continuous dB scale. A lightweight converter, trained as a conditional cycle-consistent GAN without parallel data, transforms the features of a frozen speech encoder, from which a pretrained vocoder resynthesizes the speech. We compare three representations, log-mel spectrograms, WavLM, and SpeechTokenizer, and introduce an objective protocol that measures the achieved intensity change against the target one on a calibrated corpus. translated_title: 基于对抗训练的连续声压级控制语音强度转换
translated_abstract: 语音强度转换是指将一段录音语音以不同的语音强度呈现出来，而不是简单地缩放其幅度，同时保留其内容和说话人身份。现有系统通过参考语音或少数离散类别来控制强度。与之不同，我们使用连续分贝刻度上任意设定的目标声压级（SPL）来控制转换过程。一个轻量级转换器以条件循环一致性生成对抗网络（GAN）的形式进行训练，无需平行数据，其转换冻结的语音编码器所提取的特征，再由预训练的声码器重新合成语音。我们比较了三种表示方式：log-mel频谱图、WavLM和SpeechTokenizer，并提出了一种客观评估协议，在校准语料库上测量实际达到的强度变化与目标强度变化的匹配程度。使用WavLM时，转换器实现了目标强度变化的83%，并且还能同时改变基频。感知评估……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于对抗训练的语音强度转换方法，首次实现对连续分贝刻度上任意目标声压级的精确控制，使用WavLM特征时达到了目标强度变化的83%。
